test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate of interest (R) = 7% per year

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (3000 × 7 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = 630

**The simple interest is ₹630.**
